# Sheerherb

> Xi'an Sheerherb Biological Technology Co., Ltd. (Sheerherb) manufactures private label and OEM dietary supplements in Xi'an, China, for brands, Amazon and Shopify sellers, and distributors. B2B only; not a consumer shop.

Sheerherb produces gummies, capsules, softgels, tablets, powders, drops, liposomal formulas, pellets, and throat lozenges.

## Key facts (as stated on the site)

- Address: Room 1204, Vanke Huizhi Center, Yanta District, Xi'an, Shaanxi, China. Shipments go to brands and distributors worldwide.
- MOQ on many finished SKUs starts around 500–1,000 units; the exact MOQ depends on the ingredient, dosage form, and packaging.
- Process: send the dosage form, target market, quantity, and any label files; the factory confirms formula options, a sample, then production, inspection, packing, and shipping.
- Buyers handle destination-market claims and labeling. Pages describe manufacturing, not medical treatment.

## How to inquire

Use the inquiry form at https://sheerherb-oem.com/get-a-quote/ (name, email, optional phone/WhatsApp, product, company type, channel, volume, message). Include the dosage form, target market, quantity, and label files if available.
